高等女學校諸調査 1937

全國高等女學校實科高等女學校ニ關スル諸調査 昭和12年度 (Surveys of Girls' High Schools and Practical Girls' High Schools, 1937)
文部省普通學務局 (Ministry of Education, General Education Bureau), 東京, 1938 (凡例 dated 昭和13年6月)

Every table is transcribed. The long school-by-school tables were read in four-page pieces by Claude Sonnet 5.5 and joined, each piece once, from tight crops; the 道府縣 and 設立別 of rows at the top of a page are carried from the heading on the page before. The book prints many sub-totals that do not add up (spot checks on the scan confirmed that the printed figures are as transcribed); they are kept as printed and noted in each table. Where a digit was ambiguous only between 3 and 8 and exactly one reading made a printed total reconcile, that reading is used and noted. Ditto marks (同) are kept as printed. 23 of about 112,000 filled cells could not be read and are marked [?]; unreadable characters in school and personal names are marked [illegible] in place.
